entries.title: Philemon 1:1
segments: A prisoner. This epistle was written at Rome during Paul's first imprisonment, nearly four years after his arrest at Jerusalem (
), during all of which time he had been in bonds, but permitted to preach.  See

.
 

 
 Philemon. A member of the Christian church at Colossae.
 

 
 Apphia. Believed to have been the wife of Philemon.
 

 
 Archippus. Probably an evangelist, and Philemon's son.
